note: Broad onboarding interests. Each topic's 64-D centroid is the AVERAGE of the embeddings of the real questions under its `families` (matched by text against the DB in scripts/seed-topics.ts), so the centroid sits inside its question cluster and retrieval surfaces on-topic cards. `families` are family-id prefixes from data/topic-families.json. `description` is a fallback: it is embedded (OpenAI -> compressTo64) only for a topic that matched no questions.
